(a) Spec-AC-07's post-freeze third clause said write SHALL leave untouched every file in the directory it did not itself write. The AC, the heartbeat.mjs header sentence (neither ever considers a file this script did not write — also false) and TEST-011 now state the prefix bound; CHANGELOG.md already had it right and is only extended. Shape-gating the reap on isSlotShape was the alternative and is REJECTED: it cannot cover the <slot>.tmp.<pid>.<seq> temps the sweep exists to collect. Recorded as residual R6. (b) Spec-AC-07's FIRST clause said older than 24 hours; reapAsides delegates to isStale, whose window is symmetric, so a future-dated hb- file is reaped too (reproduced at +48 h). Deliberate library semantics (runtime-file.mjs classes C+F, a far-future mtime must never wedge a GC), previously undocumented, now stated in the AC. (c) The same line-647 record narrowed WHICH PROCESS correctly and then OVER-CORRECTED in the other direction, asserting that an announced dispatch that never happened leaves NO slot file at all — that absence is the real detection, and it is the load-bearing half. The mechanism surfaces the POSITIVE half only; absence is ambiguous by construction, which is what D5's refusal to define a threshold already implied. Corrected in the spec, the heartbeat.mjs header and CHANGELOG.md together. D6, Spec-AC-08's test row and the Positioning section record the decision. (f) Residual R7 records the pre-release orphan: slot files written by the unprefixed build in the real default dir are now invisible to read AND outside their own GC's prefix bound. Immaterial — no merged tree ever ran that version — but recorded as a choice rather than left as an accident.
